**Qualifies as a lead:** not until the gaps are closed

## Summary

- AUTO-4 LIMITED (company number 01786187) is an active private limited company incorporated on 26 January 1984, filing small accounts under SIC 46900 (non-specialised wholesale trade). `[profile]`
- The board has three active officers out of twelve ever appointed, with one director appointed on 29 June 2026. `[officers]`
- Two third-party charges remain outstanding, both in favour of National Westminster Bank PLC: one created 15 November 2013 containing a fixed charge and secured on Unit 4A Park Lane Business Park, Bentinck Colliery, Kirkby in Ashfield, Notts (part of title NT421588), and one created 25 March 2005 secured on the undertaking and all property and assets present and future, including goodwill, book debts, uncalled capital, buildings, fixtures and fixed plant and machinery. Under SEC-01 no first-charge facility can be offered unless those charges are redeemed at completion. `[017861870007; created 2005-03-25 · National Westminster Bank P… #2; SEC-01]`
- SEC-08 applies because the subsisting 2005 all-assets charge carries a floating element over the whole undertaking, so we must assess what unencumbered assets, if any, remain available as security. `[created 2005-03-25 · National Westminster Bank P… #2; SEC-08]`
- Two charges to National Westminster Bank PLC were created on the same day, 25 March 2005, which SEC-06 treats as a structured or tranched facility; obtain full redemption figures for all charges before quoting any refinance. `[created 2005-03-25 · National Westminster Bank P…; created 2005-03-25 · National Westminster Bank P… #2; SEC-06]`
- Five older charges, to Midland Bank PLC (1984), National Westminster Bank PLC and individual chargees (1987), and The Royal Bank of Scotland Commercial Services Limited and National Westminster Bank PLC (2005), are fully satisfied and are disregarded for ranking purposes. `[created 1984-02-22 · Midland Bank PLC; created 1987-01-30 · National Westminster Bank P…; created 1987-01-30 · D. Wager; created 2005-03-25 · The Royal Bank of Scotland…; created 2005-03-25 · National Westminster Bank P…; SEC-03]`
- Filing conduct is mixed: the accounts to 31 December 2023 were filed on 6 January 2025, 100 days late, which triggers CON-01, although the two most recent filings (September 2025 and September 2026) were early and no accounts are currently overdue. `[AA filed 2025-01-06; AA filed 2025-09-15; AA filed 2026-09-14; profile; CON-01]`
